authority: One CanvasWorkspace owns the tool rail, layer dock, ruler gutter, active layer context, and explicit tool state
rules: Changing a layer never arms Paint or Place
The tool rail may only enable operations that have a wired adapter for the active canvas/layer
Locked reference layers grey mutating tools
Pixel Studio layer selection lives in the canvas Layer Dock rather than a second Inspector stack
Tool and layer chrome reserve canvas geometry and do not float over the drawable document
